description: This file contains JavaScript code for SuiteCRM, including class inheritance, client methods for calendar and RPC interactions, and callback functions, with licensing and contact information in comments.

classes.name: SugarVCalClient
classes.description: Client class for handling calendar-related operations, including loading and parsing calendar data.

classes.name: SugarRPCClient
classes.description: Client class for making RPC calls to the server with allowed methods such as retrieve, query, save, etc.

methods.name: method_callback
methods.description: Callback function to handle responses from asynchronous requests, updating widgets accordingly.

methods.name: SugarVCalClient.load
methods.description: Loads calendar data for a specific user and request ID, updating global registries.

methods.name: SugarVCalClient.parseResults
methods.description: Parses calendar response text into a structured time hash, adjusting for time zones and daylight saving.

methods.name: SugarRPCClient.call_method
methods.description: Performs an RPC call to the server with specified method and arguments, supporting synchronous and asynchronous modes.
